subject: Architecture
title: Palladio: The Architect Everyone Copied
description: One-minute skill: Palladio: The Architect Everyone Copied.

hook.text: Andrea Palladio was a stonemason's apprentice who became the most imitated architect in history.

buildup.text: He studied Roman ruins and wrote 'Four Books of Architecture,' a builder's manual still in print.

discovery.text: Palladio used mathematical ratios to size rooms, creating spaces that feel naturally harmonious.

twist.text: Thomas Jefferson modeled Monticello and the University of Virginia directly on Palladio's designs.

climax.text: The White House, the Capitol, and countless courthouses all trace their DNA to Palladio's villas.

punchline.text: One Italian's sketchbook shaped the face of American democracy.

quiz.question: Which American president directly copied Palladio's designs?
